title: India Sale Calendar 2026 — EORS, Pink Friday & What Is Actually Confirmed
description: Confirmed store-published windows, clearly labelled expectations, and a dated price-reveal ledger showing why a revealed sale price is not a payable one.

forWho: Shoppers planning a 2026 purchase around a sale and wanting dates a store actually published.
Anyone comparing a revealed sale price against a dated current price for the same SKU.
skipIf: Anyone treating an expected date as a live sale window — expectations are labelled and are not confirmed.
Readers wanting hands-on testing. This guide uses dated official pages and indexed listings; Durza did not buy or test any product.

content_blocks.heading: Which 2026 Indian sale dates are confirmed, and when is Nykaa's Pink Friday?
content_blocks.body: Confirmed from store-published material we checked: Myntra End of Reason Sale summer 2026 from 29 May with 50–90% off (official EORS page snippet; direct page fetch timed out on 26 Nov), and Tata CLiQ's Big CLiQ Sale 14–31 May 2026 (official press release). Nykaa's own price-reveal page showed 'Pink Friday Sale Price' labels on 26 Nov 2026 but no dates; third-party sites disagree between 21 and 27 November. Do not treat any of those third-party dates as confirmed. Winter EORS is expected in early December, not announced. Revealed prices are not payable prices — our dated ledger shows ₹719 current versus ₹559 revealed on one lip gloss, about 22.3% lower by our arithmetic.

items.title: Confirmed vs expected: the 2026 timeline
items.body: CONFIRMED — Big CLiQ Sale, 14–31 May 2026, from an official press release covering Tata CLiQ Fashion, Luxury and Palette. CONFIRMED (indexed official snippet; direct fetch timed out) — Myntra EORS summer 2026 starting 29 May, advertised at 50–90% off. CONFIRMED IN PRIOR DURZA AUDIT, NOT RE-VERIFIED TODAY — Flipkart Black Friday 21–27 Nov 2026 and Tata CLiQ Black Friday 19–30 Nov 2026. EXPECTED ONLY — winter EORS in early December (third-party guidance; Myntra's live page showed no dates). UNCONFIRMED — Nykaa Pink Friday dates: its own page showed price labels but no dates, while third-party sites variously claimed 21 November, 27 November and 21–28 November. Sources disagree, so Durza publishes no confirmed window.

items.title: A revealed price is not a payable price
items.body: Nykaa's official reveal page, last updated 25 Nov 2026, showed Maybelline Lifter Gloss at ₹799 regular, ₹719 current and ₹559 'Pink Friday Sale Price'. The ₹559 is ₹160 below the price a shopper could see on 26 Nov, about 22.3% lower by our arithmetic, and ₹240 below regular (30%). L'Oréal Telescopic Extensionist showed ₹1,099 regular and ₹824 revealed (25%). None of those amounts was confirmed as payable at checkout on 26 Nov 2026.

items.title: Build a same-SKU baseline before a sale
items.body: Match the full product name and variant, record the price you can pay today, then compare the sale price against that number — not against MRP. The Lifter Gloss example shows why: the 30% headline is measured against ₹799, while the real incremental cut from today's price is about 22%. MRP is a reference ceiling, not a record of what a product usually sold for.

items.title: What failed verification in this recheck
items.body: The direct Myntra EORS page request timed out, so its dates rest on an indexed official snippet rather than a page we fully read. We did not re-open Flipkart's or Lenovo's offer pages on 26 Nov 2026, so those earlier Durza dates and the third-party Lenovo price-history record are carried as 'earlier audit, not re-verified'. No third-party Nykaa date is promoted to a confirmed window.

items.body: Write down the exact SKU and the price you can pay today before any sale begins.
Only plan around dates marked CONFIRMED. Treat EXPECTED and UNCONFIRMED rows as watch-list items, not shopping plans.
When a sale is live, compare the final payable on the payment screen — sale price, bank offer, exchange adjustment and excluded modes.
For revealed prices, re-read the product page when the sale opens. A reveal is a label on a category page, not a payable quote.
Record the seller of record and return terms; a lower headline from a different seller is not the same purchase.
Screenshot the date and price you used as your baseline so a later strike-through cannot rewrite your comparison.

items.label: Tata CLiQ published a dated 2026 sale window.
items.value: An official press release says the Big CLiQ Sale ran 14–31 May 2026 across Tata CLiQ Fashion, Luxury and Palette. That is a confirmed window from company-issued material.

items.label: Myntra's official EORS snippet gives a start date but the page did not load.
items.value: The indexed official EORS page snippet says the sale starts 29 May 2026 with 50–90% off. A direct fetch on 26 Nov 2026 timed out, so this is an indexed official statement, not a fully re-read page.

items.label: Nykaa's reveal page shows prices, not dates.
items.value: The official page carried 'Pink Friday Sale Price' labels and a footer saying 'Last Updated: November 25, 2026'. No sale window was stated on the page we read.

items.label: Third-party Pink Friday dates conflict.
items.value: Different third-party pages claimed 21 November, 27 November and 21–28 November 2026. Durza publishes none of them as confirmed; check Nykaa's live site.

items.label: The reveal arithmetic is ours.
items.value: On the Lifter Gloss, ₹559 against ₹719 current is ₹160 lower, or about 22.25% by our calculation; against ₹799 regular it is ₹240 lower, or 30.04%. Both figures come from the same official page.

items.label: Several earlier Durza dates were not re-verified.
items.value: Flipkart Black Friday 21–27 Nov, Tata CLiQ Black Friday 19–30 Nov and the Lenovo India offer window came from an earlier audit. We did not re-open those pages on 26 Nov 2026 and label them accordingly.

content_blocks.text: We checked an official Tata CLiQ press release, an indexed official Myntra EORS snippet, Nykaa's own price-reveal page and prior Durza audit notes on 26 Nov 2026. The Myntra direct fetch timed out; Flipkart, Lenovo and some CLiQ windows were not re-verified; third-party Pink Friday dates disagree. Confirmed windows are labelled CONFIRMED, expectations are labelled EXPECTED and prior-audit figures are labelled as such. Reveal percentages are Durza's arithmetic on published figures and are not payable quotes. No product was bought or tested. Durza earns a commission on qualifying purchases through tracked links at no extra cost to you.

items: A confirmed sale window comes from a store's own published material, not from a coupon blog.
Expected dates describe a recurring pattern; they are not announcements.
A revealed price is not payable until the sale is live and the product page shows it at checkout.
Measure a discount against the recent payable price for the exact SKU, not against MRP or a strike-through.
Sources disagree on Nykaa Pink Friday 2026 dates — Durza publishes no confirmed window.
Earlier audit figures not re-checked on 26 Nov 2026 are labelled and should be confirmed on the store before planning a purchase.

items.q: Who runs the End of Reason Sale?
items.a: Myntra. Its official EORS page snippet checked 26 Nov 2026 says the summer edition starts 29 May 2026 with 50–90% off. The direct page fetch timed out, so that is an indexed official snippet. Winter EORS is expected in early December, not announced.

items.q: What Tata CLiQ sale dates are confirmed?
items.a: The Big CLiQ Sale ran 14–31 May 2026, per an official press release. Other 2026 windows in an earlier Durza audit were not re-verified on 26 Nov and are labelled as prior-audit figures.
Not confirmed. Nykaa's own reveal page showed Pink Friday price labels but no dates on 26 Nov 2026. Third-party pages claimed 21, 27 and 21–28 November. Verify on Nykaa's live site.

items.q: Can I buy a revealed Pink Friday price now?
items.a: No. The reveal page showed ₹719 current and ₹559 revealed on Maybelline Lifter Gloss, for example. The reveal is not a payable checkout price until the sale is live.

items.q: How much is the Lifter Gloss reveal actually worth?
items.a: ₹160 below the ₹719 current price, about 22.3% by our arithmetic. Against the ₹799 regular price it is ₹240, or about 30% — the larger headline uses the higher baseline.

items.q: Did Durza verify every date on this calendar?
items.a: No. Only the confirmed rows are store-published and checked. Expected and prior-audit rows are explicitly labelled, and the Myntra direct fetch timed out. Where verification failed, the guide says so.
